connector.name: Vantage - Signal Tracker
connector.registryDescription: Save and query market signals from your AI conversations.
connector.summary: Hosted at vantage.cavendo.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package vantage-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cavendo-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key in the format: Bearer vtg_YOUR_KEY
